arcs.title: The Autumn Creature Survey
arcs.summary: Day 2: A second witness — a Hogwarts field naturalist student — confirmed the creature on the ridgeline at half-past six Friday morning. Copper-coloured, fox-adjacent, sitting upright, watching the fog dissipate 'with opinions.' It glanced at the witness, determined she was not the person it was waiting for, and returned its gaze to the valley. Survey file upgraded to Provisional Amber. The creature has still not descended. Day 3 should develop what — or who — the creature appears to be waiting for, perhaps with a detail connecting it to Christine, Steve, or the Jeep trail, or a Survey Office theory about its classification that is warmly, specifically wrong.
